Вёрстка из Figma, проверенная по&nbsp;эт: Figma to code, verified against the design
Плагин выгружает макеты. Программа на ва: The plugin exports your designs. The app on your computer builds a design system from them, lays out the pages and checks each one against the design: the position of every element and every pixel. Works even for files without styles, components or Auto Layout.

Плагин только выгружает данные. Анализ,: The plugin only exports data. Analysis, layout and checking run locally — your designs are never sent anywhere.

Каждый элемент вёрстки связан со своим с: Every element in the code is linked to its Figma layer and matches its position and size. A 1 px layout error won't pass, while differences in font rendering don't affect this check.
Скриншот страницы сравнивается с PNG из: A screenshot of the page is compared with the PNG from Figma. Outside text, at most 0.1% of pixels may differ; inside text, at most 0.5%, because Figma and browsers render letter pairs differently. Thresholds are configurable.
Всё на алгоритмах, без ИИ: повторяемо, б: All algorithms, no AI: repeatable, free and verifiable.
Дизайн-система из любого макета: A design system from any file
Склеивает почти одинаковые цвета и назыв: Merges near-identical colors and names them on a 50–950 scale, detects roles: background, text, border, brand. Finds text styles, the spacing step, radii, shadows and breakpoints.
Auto Layout переносит как есть. Где его: Auto Layout is carried over as is. Where it's missing, columns and rows are built from layer positions. Absolute positioning stays only for overlapping layers and for blocks that otherwise wouldn't match the design. Icons are inlined as SVG with colors from tokens.
Измеряет каждый элемент в браузере, срав: Measures every element in the browser, compares the screenshot with the PNG from Figma and shows which layers cause the mismatch. Tries fixes for them and keeps only those that get closer to the reference: on real designs the mismatch drops from 1.98% to 0.38%.
HTML и CSS, React и Vue: HTML and CSS, React and Vue
Чистая папка с обычными HTML и CSS, кото: A clean folder of plain HTML and CSS you can put on any hosting. Repeated blocks become components, and differences between copies become props in React and Vue projects on Vite. Every version is checked against the verified layout pixel for pixel.
Макеты одной страницы под разные ширины,: Frames of one page at different widths, such as “Home / Desktop” and “Home / Mobile”, are combined into a single page. At each frame's width it matches pixel for pixel, and in between it stretches by the Figma constraints — only where nothing overlaps or overflows.
Шапка, подвал, меню, кнопки, ссылки и за: Header, footer, menus, buttons, links and headings get their tags by rules. Rotations and masks are carried over exactly. Blocks the designer named header, nav, section or form get those tags. Class names can be left to AI: a local model first, then free APIs.
По каждой странице: прошла ли проверку,: For every page: whether it passed, an overlay with a slider, a diff map, and WCAG text contrast issues.
Кнопка «Только проверить макет» за неско: The “Only check the design” button shows in a few seconds what in the file gets in the way of good code: blocks without Auto Layout, generic names, copies instead of components, missing states, variables or styles. With layer examples and a guide on how to fix them.
В каждой сборке есть AGENTS.md — карта п: Every build includes AGENTS.md — a project map: pages and frames, components, tokens, check results and rules. PNGs of all screens are in screens/, and service markers are removed from the code. The agent spends tokens on work, not on parsing noise.
Токены импортируются кнопкой в плагине:: Tokens are imported with a button in the plugin: variables, text styles and shadow styles. Re-importing updates them instead of duplicating.
DS Builder ставится как обычная программ: DS Builder installs like a regular app, no terminal needed. The Figma plugin comes with it. You need Figma Desktop and Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge: the app checks the layout in the browser.
The buttons download the latest version right away. The Figma plugin comes with the app.

Всё, что можно решить кодом, решается ко: Whatever can be solved with code is solved with code. AI is used only for tasks that need understanding, and goes through the same check with rollback if the result gets worse.
Вся логика в программе, где её можно тес: All logic lives in the app, where it can be tested without Figma. The plugin hands over data and writes back what the app has built.
Страница не считается готовой без сверки: A page isn't done until it's checked against the reference. If the check fails, the report shows where and why.
В React и Vue адаптивная страница только: In React and Vue a responsive page only switches at breakpoints, without stretching in between.
Состояния компонентов (наведение, нажати: Component states (hover, pressed, disabled) from Figma variants aren't carried into CSS yet.
Переменные из подключённых командных биб: The plugin can't see variables from connected team libraries yet.
Платные шрифты нужно установить в систем: Paid fonts have to be installed on your system yourself.
Свойства компонентов Figma как props, им: Figma component properties as props, text style names and variable bindings.
ИИ для спорной семантики и описаний карт: AI for ambiguous semantics and image descriptions — with the same check and rollback.
Нет. Плагин не обращается к сети, програ: No. The plugin doesn't use the network, and the app runs on your computer. Only the free fonts used in the design are downloaded, once, into a local cache.
Нужен ли ИИ или платные сервисы?: Do I need AI or paid services?
Нет. Анализ, вёрстка, семантика, компоне: No. Analysis, layout, semantics, components, checking and fixes all work without AI. AI is turned on with the “AI class names” checkbox in advanced settings and only suggests class names: a local model via Ollama first, then free APIs. The result still goes through the check.
Что если в макете нет стилей и Auto Layo: What if the design has no styles or Auto Layout?
Это основной сценарий. Дизайн-система со: That's the main use case. The design system is built from the values actually used, and the layout is worked out from layer positions. Scaled-down copies of screens are detected and kept out of the scales.
Как подготовить макет, чтобы вёрстка был: How do I prepare a design for better code?
Всё, что дизайнер указал явно — Auto Lay: Everything the designer specifies explicitly — Auto Layout, components, variables, state variants, block names — the app carries into code exactly, with no guessing. The designer guide explains what to do in Figma, with a checklist before export.
Зачем нужен Chrome или Edge?: Why is Chrome or Edge needed?
Вёрстка проверяется в настоящем браузере: The layout is checked in a real browser: the page is rendered, every element is measured and the screenshot is compared with the reference. The app uses Google Chrome if it's installed, otherwise Microsoft Edge, which every Windows has. If your browser is in an unusual location, set the path in the CHROME_PATH variable.
Почему Windows или macOS предупреждает п: Why does Windows or macOS show a warning during install?
У установщиков пока нет цифровой подписи: The installers aren't code-signed yet: certificates cost money. Every build of the app is tested on a sample design on all three systems before release. You only need to confirm the launch once, as described in “Install”.
Что прислать, если что-то не сработало?: What should I send if something didn't work?
Подробный журнал из окна программы (раск: The detailed log from the app window (it expands under the build stages), the plugin console (Plugins, Development, Show/Hide console), the report.json file from the build folder and, if possible, the package itself or one problematic frame.
DS Builder бесплатный и с открытым кодом: DS Builder is free and open source. If the app saves you time, you can support its development with a card transfer.
Перевод по номеру карты из приложения ва: Transfer by card number from your bank's app. Thank you!
